notes_for_editor: Brief kind 'ground' fits the 1941 cabin, but the earliest structure was a 1931 tree tower or crow's nest, so the brief's kind may need a 'tree' note. No height, access or current-condition source was found, so those keys are left out. The Forest Lookouts 'Removed' line has no date, so no removal event. The panorama is credited to National Archives Pacific Northwest Region in the register text, but no image URL was fetched, so no photos entry. Two WebSearch-style searches returned no description of the site today.
